seo.title: Sample project: Sooke broom and brush clearing
seo.description: Sample case study: Scotch broom and blackberry cleared from a Sooke acreage, keeping young firs and arbutus, with proper invasive disposal.

summary: Scotch broom and blackberry cleared from a rural lot while keeping native trees.
challenge: Scotch broom and blackberry had closed in the driveway and a field on a rural Sooke lot, around young native trees the owners wanted to keep.
approach: We cut and pulled broom before it set seed and cleared the blackberry, working around the young firs and arbutus.
Invasive material was kept separate from other brush and disposed of following CRD guidance.
result: An open driveway and field, with native trees kept.
links: Read more about [tree and vegetation work](/services/tree-vegetation/), see our work in [Sooke](/areas/sooke/), or [get a free quote](/free-quote/).
